name: Ijagbo Offa
queryAndRequestSummary: Separate English and Yoruba discovery was performed. First-party Kwara State Government and KWGIS pages were retrieved, and the official KWGIS E-Services WordPress page plus its REST representation were inspected for current viewer/configuration/API routes. The pages evidence KWGIS as a state land/GIS custodian and describe digital land administration, but no public anonymous parcel service, schema, CRS, or ID+geometry response was exposed.
